data: Microsoft reported diluted earnings per share of $9.68 in fiscal 2023 (year ended June 30, 2023), compared with $9.65 in fiscal 2022, an increase of about 0.3%. Net income in fiscal 2023 was $72,361 million, or roughly $72.4 billion, which was slightly below the $72,738 million earned in fiscal 2022. EPS still edged up because the diluted share count fell from 7,540 million to 7,472 million.
